spend_field_caveat: `total_usd` ($28.9812) exceeds `brain_usd` ($26.5741) by $2.4071: targets $0.0000 + pod $2.4071. Target generations are served on the project's own pod, so their cost appears as pod time rather than as per-token target spend - that pod component is the whole of the difference.
